subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**with**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses augmented reality, where a virtual environment coexists with the actual world.
 
• The appropriate preposition here should indicate that the virtual environment exists alongside or together with the real world.
 
• "With" is the correct choice, as it indicates coexistence between two things, in this case, the virtual environment and the real world.
 
• Other options ("behind", "along", "beyond") do not correctly convey the idea of coexistence as intended in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"Behind" suggests something is at the back of the real world, which does not fit the concept of augmented reality coexisting with the real world.
 
• **Option 3: **"Along" implies moving alongside, which doesn’t correctly express the coexistence of the virtual and real world.
 
• **Option 4: **"Beyond" implies something that is further away, which doesn’t align with the idea of two environments coexisting.
